name: secret-guard
description: Hides your project's .env values from tool results before Claude reads them

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: value: hide .env values found in tool results. command: refuse any call whose input names a .env file.

identifierKeys.title: Identifier keys
identifierKeys.description: Comma-separated .env keys that hold names, not secrets (a login name that appears in ordinary paths); never hidden.
